---
title: "Download Raw Data"
format: html
---

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here")
}

library(here) 
# before the code created a new file under data/raw so it became data/raw/data/raw/video_view.csv when running with "preview". 
# this library and code change in line 19 from "data_dir <- file.path("data", "raw")" --> "data_dir <- here("data", "raw")" solves the problem. 

# URL of the dataset
data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hannesdatta/course-dprep/refs/heads/main/material/project/video_view.csv"

# Define the folder and file path
data_dir <- here("data", "raw") 
data_file <- file.path(data_dir, "video_view.csv") 

# Create data/raw if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Download only if the file does not already exist
if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  download.file(
    url = data_url,
    destfile = data_file,
    mode = "wb"
  ) # this means 
  
  message("Data downloaded to: ", data_file)
} else {
  message("File already exists. Download skipped.")
}

video_view <- read.csv(data_file)
View(video_view)
```
